closing_stock_share_pool_cross_validated.rule: Harappa part derived on a random half of the pool with the threshold scaled to 3 closing legends, union with DK-G, share on the other half; 200 splits

rules.closing_stock: union of the DK-G stock (stratigraphy package, discovery-v2/frozen-parameters.json) and the Harappa pool stock: signs closing at least 5 legends of two or more signs whose closing is read, with at least half their occurrences in those legends final
rules.pool: every Harappa seal family outside Vats's Mound F stratified seals, legend chosen by build_inputs.legend_face, positions read by period_stats.edge_text_fields

constants_basis: Chosen on synthetic Mound F-shaped populations in design-v1/power-quick.json: opening and closing categories need at least 5 legends and inventory signs at least 8 (false-positive rates 0.03-0.07, power 0.61-0.66 for a period-specific opening in one legend of four, 0.58 for a period-specific interior sign in one legend of two, 0.96 for period-specific closing signs in half the stock-closing legends); the equivalence margin of 0.25 passes 54% of null populations and 11% of populations with a true 0.20 shift; the permutation fail rule replaces the bootstrap 95% rule, which failed 7.7% of null populations.
